svg.text: declared: the entry point every chair reaches through
The meta-mandala as a solar system
angle = sector (13) · radius = evidence, earned inward · saturation constant per ring · size = degree
evidence = (earned + corroborated) / all vectors — this render's own scalar, not issue #8's
the star — the Composer, 4.9% of paths, rank 6
the Corona — 20 bodies that orbit him, not a chair
Spacetime — 5 Structure principles, drawn as the rings themselves
chair spoke — points at its bodies; faint = they point everywhere
Spacetime — the geometry, not bodies in it
